title: Update-invalidation compares org-wrapped original against raw updated model, skipping cache invalidations
description: update() passes wrapped model as original but compares against raw updated model. When org state changes (e.g., disabling/enabling), org-aware predicates return false while raw model changes remain undetected, causing cache invalidations to be skipped and disabled org brokers to appear on login pages after org re-enablement.

title: Test cleanup registers literal "alias" instead of actual alias names, causing 21 IDP leaks
description: Test cleanup attempts to remove identity provider with literal string "alias" instead of actual names (idp-alias-0 through idp-alias-20). Since NotFoundException is silently swallowed, 21 IDPs leak into shared realm, making test execution order-dependent.
